assumption: Frozen C11/source-native/I03/I05/I04/whole-machine law is semantic authority; R4 physical accidents are not.
if_false: Reject any physical mechanism that changes logical truth.

assumption: C11 canonical package projection is order-invariant and based on sorted exact refs; storage order itself is nonsemantic.
if_false: External canonicalization must reproduce frozen projection; arrival order cannot substitute.

assumption: Current Parquet carrier materializes whole relations for write/reopen and therefore is not the required bounded design.
if_false: If code changes before implementation, remeasure mechanics but retain bounded proof requirement.

assumption: The count of logical C11 relation families is fixed by the frozen carrier contract, even though row counts are unbounded.
if_false: Root descriptor memory could scale if relation families become unbounded; redesign root inventory hierarchy.

assumption: A maximum single logical row may be larger than the configured ordinary batch cap; no exact carrier can use less memory than is required to represent/process that row once.
if_false: Introduce bounded streaming field encoding for giant values or reject oversized rows explicitly; never pretend B_rows alone proves boundedness.

assumption: Chosen Parquet/Arrow writer can be configured so dictionary/page/row-group/footer/internal state is capped per shard.
authority_or_evidence: not yet proven; C16 candidate and backend behavior
if_false: Reject Parquet configuration or use a simpler independently closed bounded container until proven.

assumption: Same-filesystem rename plus file/directory fsync supplies the baseline durable atomic publication primitive on the target local filesystem.
authority_or_evidence: POSIX-style platform assumption; current R4 uses os.replace but without full durability protocol
if_false: Provide storage-specific transactional/CAS publication adapter; do not claim atomic seal semantics.

assumption: Per-relation external run sort with fixed merge fan-in can reproduce every required C11 canonical tie decision without retaining all refs.
authority_or_evidence: C11 canonical sorting plus replay deterministic_tie_order_rules_ref
if_false: Fail closed on ambiguous ties; compare against R03 oracle before acceptance.

assumption: Carrier-level duplicate handling must preserve multiplicity and may not invent last/first-write-wins semantics.
authority_or_evidence: source-native topology law; C11 event occurrence validation; repository exact-ref collision law
if_false: Any physical dedup/overwrite must be removed unless independently authorized by frozen logical law.

assumption: Worst-case O(N) exact lookup is acceptable for the conservative R01 correctness baseline because the campaign requires exact reconstruction, not a latency target.
authority_or_evidence: 53 R01 mission; 52 assigns acceleration/endgame proposals elsewhere
if_false: If synthesis sets a latency bound, layer an independently proven physical index without making it semantic authority.

assumption: Correctness-independent caches can be bounded and fully deleted/rebuilt without changing answers.
if_false: If cache deletion changes output, cache has become hidden authority and proposal fails.

assumption: Reader/audit can stream relation inventories and shards without materializing directory listings, member maps, or whole relations.
if_false: Reject implementation paths that call whole-directory/list/table materializers at corpus scale.

assumption: Unreferenced filesystem garbage is non-authoritative; sealed inventories define canonical members, with strict audit optionally detecting extras without an in-memory filename set.
authority_or_evidence: proposed publication law; subject to R05 canonical-copy ruling
if_false: Defer to stronger R05 member/canonical-copy rule if conflict exists.

assumption: The accepted decoder normal chunked path can supply stable row-ordinal incidence in bounded batches.
if_false: If future decoder loses stable bounded incidence, C15 pipeline cannot claim boundedness.

assumption: The accepted exact-encoding compatibility decoder path currently retains a full frame and therefore prevents an end-to-end bounded-memory claim for affected sources.
if_false: Prove an equivalent chunked compatibility path or keep end-to-end boundedness explicitly unclaimed.

assumption: No raw-source probe is needed to answer R01's physical design questions.
authority_or_evidence: checked-in authorities, scale returns, accepted code
if_false: If a later implementation exposes a named source-physical ambiguity, obey campaign Section 3 before probing.

assumption: Lazy sealed-release views can replace eager physical reopen without changing file-neutral C11 semantics, provided every accepted consumer observes the same objects, refs, counts, failures, and replay closure.
authority_or_evidence: whole-machine downstream-carrier-ignorance law; C11 file-neutral repository intent
if_false: If a consumer requires eager tuple identity as semantics, halt and adjudicate; do not silently change behavior.

assumption: Telemetry is observational only and may fail or be dropped without affecting canonical output/order.
authority_or_evidence: C17 physical-only role; whole-machine semantic boundary
if_false: If telemetry feeds decisions affecting canonical results, it must be removed or separately authorized.
